description_en: Queries deployed applications in published delivery groups under the current Alibaba Cloud account for a specified product type by paging, and returns each application along with its delivery group and the number of authorized users by application. Supports filtering by delivery group, application, and user authorization status
description_zh: 分页查询当前阿里云账号下指定产品类型的已发布交付组中已部署的应用，返回每个应用及其所属交付组和按应用授权的用户数量，支持按交付组、应用和用户授权情况筛选
name: ListPublishedApps

parameters.help_en:
The product type. This parameter is required. The value is case-insensitive. Only applications in published delivery groups of the specified product type are returned. If an unrecognized value is specified, the error code `InvalidParameter.ProductType` is returned. Filtering and statistics related to per-application authorization (`ExcludeUserId` and `AuthorizedUserCount`) are primarily used in WUYING Cloud Application common scenarios.

Valid values:

`CloudApp`: WUYING Cloud Application.
`CloudBrowser`: Cloud Browser.
`WuyingServer`: Enterprise Workstation.
`WuyingWorkstation`: Personal Edition Lingjou Container Workstation.
`WuyingWorkstationTeam`: Team Edition Lingjou Container Workstation.
`WuyingWorkstationBusiness`: Dedicated Edition Lingjou Container Workstation.
`AndroidCloud`: Cloud Phone.
`AIAgent`: AgentBay (AI agent)
parameters.help_zh:
产品类型，必填，取值不区分大小写。只返回该产品类型下已发布交付组中的应用；传入无法识别的取值时返回错误码 `InvalidParameter.ProductType`。按应用授权相关的筛选与统计（`ExcludeUserId`、`AuthorizedUserCount`）主要用于无影云应用场景。

取值：

`CloudApp`：无影云应用。
`CloudBrowser`：云浏览器。
`WuyingServer`：企业版工作站。
`WuyingWorkstation`：个人版灵构容器工作站。
`WuyingWorkstationTeam`：灵构团队版容器工作站。
`WuyingWorkstationBusiness`：灵构专属版容器工作站。
`AndroidCloud`：云手机。
`AIAgent`：AgentBay（AI 智能体）
parameters.name: product_type

parameters.help_en: The page number. This parameter is required. Start from page `1` and use this parameter together with `PageSize`. Keep other filter conditions unchanged when querying subsequent pages. If an invalid value is specified, the error code `InvalidParameter.PageNumber` is returned
parameters.help_zh: 查询页码，必填。请从第 `1` 页开始查询，并与 `PageSize` 配合使用；查询后续页时保持其他筛选条件不变。取值不合法时返回错误码 `InvalidParameter.PageNumber`
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of application records to return per page. This parameter is required. Valid values: `1` to `100`. If the value is out of range, the error code `InvalidParameter.PageSize` is returned
parameters.help_zh: 每页最多返回的应用记录数量，必填。取值范围为 `1`～`100`，单位为条。超出范围时返回错误码 `InvalidParameter.PageSize`
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The delivery group ID used for filtering. Substring matching is supported. You can specify a complete ID or a consecutive segment of it. If this parameter is not specified or is set to an empty string, filtering by delivery group ID is not applied. You can call the [ListAppInstanceGroup](~~ListAppInstanceGroup~~) operation to obtain delivery group IDs. This parameter can be used together with other filter conditions, and all conditions must be met simultaneously
parameters.help_zh: 用于筛选的交付组 ID，支持包含匹配。可传入完整 ID 或其中的连续片段；不传或为空字符串时不按交付组 ID 筛选。可调用 [ListAppInstanceGroup](~~ListAppInstanceGroup~~) 接口获取交付组 ID。可与其他筛选条件同时使用，结果须同时满足所有条件
parameters.name: app_instance_group_id

parameters.help_en: The delivery group name used for filtering. Substring matching is supported. For example, if you specify `OfficeApps`, delivery groups whose names contain this text are matched. If this parameter is not specified or is set to an empty string, filtering by delivery group name is not applied. If both this parameter and the delivery group ID are specified, both conditions must be met
parameters.help_zh: 用于筛选的交付组名称，支持包含匹配。例如传入 `办公应用`，可匹配名称中包含该文本的交付组。不传或为空字符串时不按交付组名称筛选；与交付组 ID 同时传入时，须同时满足
parameters.name: app_instance_group_name

parameters.help_en: The application ID used for filtering. Substring matching is supported. You can specify a complete ID or a consecutive segment of it. If this parameter is not specified or is set to an empty string, filtering by application ID is not applied. If both this parameter and `AppName` are specified, both conditions must be met by the same application
parameters.help_zh: 用于筛选的应用 ID，支持包含匹配。可传入完整 ID 或其中的连续片段；不传或为空字符串时不按应用 ID 筛选。与 `AppName` 同时传入时，须由同一应用同时满足
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The application name used for filtering. Substring matching is supported. For example, if you specify `OfficeApps`, applications whose names contain this text are matched. If this parameter is not specified or is set to an empty string, filtering by application name is not applied. If both this parameter and `AppId` are specified, both conditions must be met by the same application
parameters.help_zh: 用于筛选的应用名称，支持包含匹配。例如传入 `办公应用`，可匹配名称中包含该文本的应用。不传或为空字符串时不按应用名称筛选；与 `AppId` 同时传入时，须由同一应用同时满足
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en:
The username to exclude. Exact username matching is used. For example, `alice`. When specified, applications that have been authorized to this user through [AuthorizeUsersForApp](~~AuthorizeUsersForApp~~) by application are not returned. This helps you find applications that can still be authorized to the user. If this parameter is not specified or is set to an empty string, no exclusion based on user authorization is applied.

Access permissions granted through delivery-group-level authorization or user groups are not evaluated by this condition. The returned results cannot be treated as a complete list of applications that the user has no access to
parameters.help_zh:
需要排除的用户名，按完整用户名匹配，例如 `alice`。传入后，已通过 [AuthorizeUsersForApp](~~AuthorizeUsersForApp~~) 按应用授权给该用户的应用不会返回，可用于查找仍可为该用户授权的应用；不传或为空字符串时，不按用户授权情况排除。

通过交付组整体授权或用户组获得的访问权限不由本条件判断。 不能据此把返回结果等同于该用户完全无权访问的应用列表
parameters.name: exclude_user_id

schema.description_en: The result of this paged query, including the request ID, pagination information, total number of matching records, and the application list for the current page
schema.description_zh: 本次分页查询的结果，包括请求 ID、分页信息、匹配记录总数和当前页的应用列表

Apps.description_en: The list of application records on the current page. Each record corresponds to a deployed application in a published delivery group. The list is sorted by the creation time of the delivery group in descending order. An empty list is returned if no results match or the requested page exceeds the result range
Apps.description_zh: 当前页的应用记录列表，每条记录对应一个已发布交付组中的一个已部署应用，按所属交付组的创建时间从新到旧排序。没有匹配结果或请求页超出结果范围时，返回空列表

items.description_en: A deployed application in a published delivery group, including the application identifier, version, icon, the delivery group it belongs to, and the number of users authorized by application
items.description_zh: 一个已发布交付组中的一个已部署应用，包含应用标识、版本、图标、所属交付组及按应用授权的用户数量

AppIcon.description_en: The URL of the application icon

AppId.description_en: The application ID. Pass this value together with `AppInstanceGroupId` when you invoke the [AuthorizeUsersForApp](~~AuthorizeUsersForApp~~) operation to authorize users for this application
AppId.description_zh: 应用 ID。调用 [AuthorizeUsersForApp](~~AuthorizeUsersForApp~~) 接口为该应用授权用户时，与 `AppInstanceGroupId` 一同传入此值

AppInstanceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the published delivery group to which this application belongs
AppInstanceGroupId.description_zh: 该应用所属已发布交付组的 ID

AppInstanceGroupName.description_en: The name of the published delivery group to which this application belongs
AppInstanceGroupName.description_zh: 该应用所属已发布交付组的名称

AppVersionName.description_en: The application version name, which is the name assigned to this version when the application was published
AppVersionName.description_zh: 应用版本名称，即应用发布时为该版本设置的名称

AuthorizedUserCount.description_en: The number of users authorized by application for this application within its delivery group. Only users authorized through [AuthorizeUsersForApp](~~AuthorizeUsersForApp~~) by application are counted. The value is `0` if no users have been authorized by application
AuthorizedUserCount.description_zh: 该应用当前在所属交付组内按应用授权的用户数量，单位为个。仅统计通过 [AuthorizeUsersForApp](~~AuthorizeUsersForApp~~) 按应用授权的用户；未按应用授权任何用户时返回 `0`

PageNumber.description_en: The page number specified in this request
PageNumber.description_zh: 本次请求指定的查询页码

PageSize.description_en: The number of records per page specified in this request. This value does not represent the actual number of records returned on the current page. The actual number may be less than this value
PageSize.description_zh: 本次请求指定的每页记录数量，单位为条。该值不表示当前页实际返回数量；当前页实际数量可能小于该值

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use this ID to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，可用于定位请求问题

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of records that match all filter conditions. Records are counted on a per-delivery-group-plus-application basis. If the same application appears in multiple published delivery groups, each combination is counted separately. This value does not represent the number of records returned on the current page. The value is `0` if no results match
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合全部筛选条件的记录总数，单位为条。按“交付组 + 应用”组合计数，同一应用出现在多个已发布交付组中时分别计入；该值不是当前页返回数量，没有匹配结果时为 `0`
